description: What AHC's Hamilton STARlet accepts in a layout, and how VENUS labware that PyLabRobot does not define goes to AHC. `carriers`, `labware` and `tracks` are a fallback copy of AHC 0.9.3 (github.com/xthomaswang/ahc, src/ahc/devices/hamilton/starlet.md, `layout`, 2026-11-12): pipeline/ahc_export.py reads the installed AHC plugin's own list when it finds one, so a newer AHC needs no edit here. Names are matched ignoring case. `equivalents` is by VENUS type: the AHC type that stands for the same physical item, with what differs. Add an entry when the deck holds VENUS labware that AHC models under another name.

RGT_CONT_50ml_A00.note: the same Hamilton trough: AHC's model is 19 x 90 mm and 60 mL, VENUS's 20 x 90 mm and 63 mL in 8 connected positions

Cos_96_PCR.note: AHC has no PCR plate, so it gets the 96-well plate AHC has run on this carrier: on a PLT_CAR_L5_DWP its wells are 0.4 mm off in x, their bottom 0.86 mm higher, 10.67 mm deep where VENUS says 20.5, and 360 uL where VENUS says 290
